_readme: AutoMod rule definitions, applied with: python -m src.main automod-apply --yes
TIERING PRINCIPLE: hard-block the VECTOR (file hosts, shorteners, trade
solicitation), only ALERT on the CHATTER. 'Rockstar responded to the leaked
footage' is a sentence your members will legitimately write - blocking it makes
the server unusable and pushes real discussion into DMs where you have zero
AUTOMOD'S BLIND SPOT: it cannot scan attachments, images or video AT ALL. The
real threat is a dragged-in .mp4, invisible to every rule below. The actual
control for that is a PERMISSION: deny Attach Files + Embed Links to @everyone
TIMEOUT actions are omitted by default: they require the bot to hold
MODERATE_MEMBERS (1099511627776), which is not in the recommended invite.
Add timeouts by hand in the UI if you want them.
Limits: 6 KEYWORD rules per guild, 1000 keywords per rule, 10 regex patterns
per rule, 260 chars per pattern, custom_message max 150 chars.

rules.name: LEAK BLOCK: file hosts
rules.custom_message: Blocked: file-host links are not allowed here. Sharing leaked GTA 6 media puts you and this server at legal risk. See #rules.
rules._note: wetransfer/terabox/sendspace have legitimate uses, but in a GTA news server the legitimate need is ~zero and the downside is high. Move any that generate real complaints into the watch rule instead of deleting them.

rules.name: LEAK BLOCK: mirrors and shorteners
rules.custom_message: Blocked: link shorteners and clip mirrors are not allowed - they hide the destination. Post the original source link instead.
rules._note: Shorteners are the standard indirection layer for leak distribution - they defeat any domain denylist by hiding the destination. '*imgur.com/a/*' targets ALBUMS (a multi-frame leak vector) while leaving single-image i.imgur.com links usable.

rules.name: LEAK BLOCK: trade solicitation
rules.custom_message: Blocked: asking for or offering leaked GTA 6 media is not allowed, including via DM. This rule protects you legally. See #rules.
rules._note: Maps directly onto Discord's 'prohibits coordinating such access' language. Requesting or offering leaked media is itself the ToS violation, regardless of whether anything is actually posted.

rules.name: LEAK BLOCK: obfuscated hosts and signatures
rules.custom_message: Blocked by the leaked-media filter. If you think this was a mistake, contact a moderator - do not repost it.
rules._note: Rust regex: NO lookahead, lookbehind or backreferences. The research's 'spaced-out hostname' pattern (m e g a . n z) is deliberately EXCLUDED from this blocking rule and moved to the watch rule below, because its \W? separators false-positive on ordinary text. Promote it here only after a clean week in the alert channel.

rules.name: LEAK WATCH: chatter (alert only)
rules._note: DELIBERATELY DOES NOT BLOCK. Its job is to tell moderators where attention is needed. Blocking legitimate news discussion would make the server unusable and drive real conversation into DMs where you have no visibility.
